name: Adventure World · 原单机
Adventure World · original solo
tag: 历史对照 · R6 单机包装
release: 历史游戏 · 当前试玩适配
subtitle: 孩子喜欢超能力、角色切换、声音反馈和喂狗/拾取。
Children liked powers, character switching, sound feedback, feeding the puppy and collecting.
strength: 孩子喜欢超能力、角色切换、声音反馈和喂狗/拾取。
Children liked powers, character switching, sound feedback, feeding the puppy and collecting.
limit: 本版本保留原玩法；旧问题与原测试不抹去。浏览器适配检查不等于实体 iPad 全流程验收。

detail: 原课堂版记录：课堂报告摇杆粘住、双击缩放与夜间目标不清；本轮不冒称已修好原版。
Original classroom record: The class reported stuck joystick input, double-tap zoom and unclear night goals. This archive does not claim those old-build issues are fixed.

title: 先说证据，不只说“好玩/不好玩”
Give evidence, not just “good/bad”
practice: 轮流说不同意见，举出喜欢的音效和互动，描述摇杆、缩放与夜游卡点。
Take turns with distinct feedback, naming sounds/interactions and joystick, zoom and night-goal problems.
knowledge: 用户测试关注完成目标的实际障碍，不只看功能数量。
Usability testing examines real obstacles to goals, not just feature counts.
expression: “At … I did …; I expected … but saw …; therefore I suggest …”

title: 把使用设备放进需求
Include the real device in the requirement
practice: 从“做多人游戏”补充到“大家都用 iPad，没有键盘”。
Refine “multiplayer game” to “everyone uses an iPad with no keyboard”.
knowledge: 功能完整不等于可用；输入方式、可视区和多人条件属于验收条件。
Feature completeness is not usability; input, viewport and networking belong in acceptance criteria.
expression: “谁用、在哪台设备、没有什么、必须完成什么动作。”
“Who uses it, on which device, without what, and which action must work.”
level: 原始反馈可核验；补充发生在返工阶段

title: 让 AI 复述，再授权
Ask the AI to restate before authorizing
practice: 世界结构、三人同服、首版重点和不做项被复述后，教师给出开发指令。
The world, shared play, priorities and exclusions are restated before the teacher authorizes development.
knowledge: 需求对齐与版本范围：确认结果和边界，而非只确认模型听见了。
Alignment and scope: confirm the intended result and boundaries, not merely that the model heard you.
expression: “请按你的理解复述：目标、场景、规则、不做项和怎样证明完成。”
“Restate the goal, scene, rules, exclusions and evidence of completion.”

title: 聊天需要轮次和停顿
Conversation needs turns and pauses
practice: 教师要求听清别人、避免重复，并给 AI 一个可以回应的停顿。
The teacher asks students to listen, avoid repetition and leave a pause for the AI to respond.
knowledge: 多人协作中的信息分工：一次讲清一个完整意图，减少重叠和漏听。
Collaborative communication: state one complete intention at a time to reduce overlap and omissions.
expression: “我补充一个不同的点……说完了，请你复述。”
“I have one different point … that is all; please restate it.”
level: 已练习；不推断每人已熟练掌握

title: 单机、联机和展示托管是三件事
Solo play, networking and hosting differ
practice: 旧版三人共创但各自单机；新版本需要服务端共享世界；GitHub 保存源码与展示。
The old co-created game is solo; new builds need a shared server; GitHub stores code and the showcase.
knowledge: 客户端负责交互/渲染，服务端负责共享状态；Pages 静态页面不等于 WebSocket 服务。
Clients handle input/rendering; the server handles shared state. A static Pages site is not a WebSocket server.
expression: “这个状态只在我的设备上，还是大家共享？服务器关了会怎样？”
“Is this state local or shared? What happens if the server stops?”
level: 课堂现象＋实现记录的工程复盘
Retrospective grounded in class experience and code

title: HUD 修复要验证边界
A HUD fix needs boundary checks
practice: 以 Joey 的设备现象为起点，对比修复前后按钮是否处于可见区域并可命中。
Start with Joey’s report and compare whether controls are inside the visible area and hittable.
knowledge: 布局视口不一定等于实际可视区；浏览器工具栏、旋转和键盘都可能改变边界。
The layout viewport may differ from the visible viewport; browser bars, rotation and keyboards can change bounds.
expression: “哪台设备、哪个方向、哪块控件、边界在哪里、修完后怎样复测？”
“Which device/orientation/control/boundary, and how will we retest the fix?”
level: 教师现场命名；深入原理由代码与测试补充
Term introduced in class; deeper explanation comes from code/tests

questions: 三个人各开一个网页，为什么不一定是联机？
Why are three open webpages not necessarily multiplayer?
请用“设备→动作→预期→实际”再报告一个问题。
Report one issue as device → action → expected → actual.
两版各有哪一点值得保留？你怎样验证，而不是凭模型名字决定？
What is worth keeping from each build, and how would you test it without judging by the model’s name?
requirements: 三个人真的在同一个世界
Three people in the same world
不是三个设备各自单机；第三人称 3D、类似 Roblox 的可见同伴和共享结果。
Not three independent games: third-person 3D with visible peers and shared outcomes.
大厅连接三种体验
A lobby links three experiences
主题乐园保留超能力、换角色、声音；野外有果树、篝火和天气；农场喂动物、收产品、建小屋。
Powers, appearance changes and sound in the park; fruit, fire and weather outdoors; feeding, produce and a cabin on the farm.
好看、好玩，而且会玩
Looks good, feels good, makes sense
操作顺、不掉链子、任务指引清楚；首版不做灾难系统和自由抓取/编辑。
Smooth reliable controls and clear guidance; disasters and unrestricted grabbing/editing are deferred.
大家都在用 iPad，没有键盘
Everyone is on iPad, without keyboards
Opus 首版交付后再次明确这一条件；Joey 在蓝色 iPad 上具体报告底部 HUD 不完整。
The condition was reiterated after the Opus delivery. Joey specifically reported clipped bottom HUD controls on the blue iPad.

title: 孩子们描述自己的乐园
The children imagine their park
summary: 汇总水上乐园、动物园、小狗、飞行、隐形与夜间手电线索。未核实每项点子具体由谁提出，因此只记三人共创。
Waterpark, zoo, puppy, flight, invisibility and torch-lit night clues. Individual attribution is unverified, so these remain shared ideas.
brief: 汇总水上乐园、动物园、小狗、飞行、隐形与夜间手电线索。未核实每项点子具体由谁提出，因此只记三人共创。
Waterpark, zoo, puppy, flight, invisibility and torch-lit night clues. Individual attribution is unverified, so these remain shared ideas.
tool: 课堂交流 → 老师归纳 → 后续历史摘要；并非完整逐字稿。
Classroom discussion → teacher synthesis → later historical summary, not a verbatim transcript.
tech: 此节点是需求，不是代码已完成的证据。
This records requirements, not completed code.
result: 确定免费、温和探索的世界方向。
Established a free, gentle exploration world.

title: 把共创想法变成 Spec v1.0
Turn shared ideas into Spec v1.0
summary: 三枚印章、三条线索、三种外观和星灯结局用于组织可玩闭环，是设计补充，不冒充孩子原话。
Three stamps, three clues, three avatar looks and a star-light finale organize a playable loop; these are design additions, not invented student quotes.
brief: 三枚印章、三条线索、三种外观和星灯结局用于组织可玩闭环，是设计补充，不冒充孩子原话。
Three stamps, three clues, three avatar looks and a star-light finale organize a playable loop; these are design additions, not invented student quotes.
tool: 整理要求 → 明确不做项 → 规格与验收条件。该次任务只制作 Spec。
Organize requirements → define exclusions → write specification and acceptance criteria. That task produced the spec only.
tech: 选择静态 Canvas 2D / 2.5D 浏览器游戏；单机、键盘和触屏、英语与简体中文。
Static Canvas 2D / 2.5D browser game; solo, keyboard/touch, English and Simplified Chinese.
result: SPEC_READY 是编制时状态，不代表今天仍未开发。
SPEC_READY was the status at authoring time, not today’s implementation status.

title: 生成实际游戏与模块
Implement the playable game
summary: 把乐园、活动和昼夜线索连接起来，不用页面按钮冒充游戏。
Connect park areas, activities and day/night clues into a game, rather than disconnected menu pages.
brief: 把乐园、活动和昼夜线索连接起来，不用页面按钮冒充游戏。
Connect park areas, activities and day/night clues into a game, rather than disconnected menu pages.
tool: Git 记录全游戏、测试与素材实现。具体模型和逐请求 Token 回执尚未核实，不从提交作者猜测。
Git records the full game, tests and assets. Exact model and per-request token receipts are unverified; commit authors do not establish model identity.
tech: JavaScript 模块分离状态、碰撞、任务、小狗、输入、存档、绘制和音效。
JavaScript modules separate state, collision, quests, puppy, input, saves, rendering and audio.
result: 实现提交 5a1db9d；后续测试与修订继续保留。
Implementation commit 5a1db9d, followed by reviews and refinements.

title: 点击移动与离线入口
Tap-to-move and the offline entry
summary: 降低操作门槛：点地面移动、点击交互提示；补屏幕操作说明。
Lower the control barrier with ground taps, clickable interaction prompts and on-screen instructions.
brief: 降低操作门槛：点地面移动、点击交互提示；补屏幕操作说明。
Lower the control barrier with ground taps, clickable interaction prompts and on-screen instructions.
tool: 提交 aac8dc3 增加操作和 bundle；392ed68 整理仓库依赖，不是一套新游戏。
Commit aac8dc3 adds controls and a bundle; 392ed68 cleans repository dependencies, not a different game.
tech: src/data → 构建脚本 → 单文件 bundle.js；运行时不依赖 Node 或在线模型。
src/data → build script → standalone bundle.js; the game does not require Node or an online model at runtime.
result: 已有游戏支持直接浏览器运行；核心任务方向未改变。
The existing game can run in the browser without changing the core quest direction.

title: 独立主线复核与三项跟进
Independent core review and three follow-ups
summary: 通过真实输入完成滑梯、动物园、小狗、夜游线索和星灯结局。中文与触屏不能因核心通关而自动通过。
Real-input checks cover the slide, zoo, puppy, night clues and finale. A core pass does not automatically certify language or touch quality.
brief: 通过真实输入完成滑梯、动物园、小狗、夜游线索和星灯结局。中文与触屏不能因核心通关而自动通过。
Real-input checks cover the slide, zoo, puppy, night clues and finale. A core pass does not automatically certify language or touch quality.
tool: 记录中的 Chromium 主线无传送、无胜利状态注入；另有 WebKit 触屏冒烟和单元测试 10/10。
The recorded Chromium run used no teleport or injected victory state. Separate WebKit touch smoke checks and 10/10 unit tests are documented.
tech: 旧测试中的坐标夹具单列；增加真实路径证据，并验证 bundle 与源码一致。
Older coordinate fixtures remain a separate test category; real-route evidence and bundle/source consistency were added.
result: PASS_CORE / ACCEPT_WITH_FOLLOWUPS；AW-01 中文、AW-02 触屏、AW-03 可重复主线仍有跟进。
PASS_CORE / ACCEPT_WITH_FOLLOWUPS, with AW-01 language, AW-02 touch and AW-03 reproducible-route follow-ups.

title: 区分文档回退与游戏版本
Separate documentation rollback from gameplay
summary: 历史中出现文档归档及其回退，不能据此断言游戏重新开发或已经丢失。
The history contains a documentation archive and its revert; that does not establish a gameplay rebuild or loss.
brief: 历史中出现文档归档及其回退，不能据此断言游戏重新开发或已经丢失。
The history contains a documentation archive and its revert; that does not establish a gameplay rebuild or loss.
tool: 核对当前 Git HEAD、归档/回退提交与运行文件指纹。
Checked current Git HEAD, archive/revert commits and runtime file fingerprints.
tech: 当前源仓库 HEAD 为 90a9d48；公开试玩 bundle 的 Git blob 与该仓库一致。
Source HEAD is 90a9d48; the published playable bundle has the same Git blob as the source repository.
result: 继续使用已核验核心基线，不把较新的文档提交当作更高游戏版号。
Continue the reviewed core baseline; a newer documentation commit is not a higher gameplay release.

title: R5 HUB 与独立测评记录
R5 HUB and individual playtest records
summary: 接入老师锁定的 R5，呈现共创过程、预算、已知问题；让每位孩子从 HUB 试玩并写报告。
Apply the teacher-approved R5, showing shared ideas, budget and known issues; let each child play from the HUB and write a report.
brief: 接入老师锁定的 R5，呈现共创过程、预算、已知问题；让每位孩子从 HUB 试玩并写报告。
Apply the teacher-approved R5, showing shared ideas, budget and known issues; let each child play from the HUB and write a report.
tool: 读取 Git 与交接单 → 校验 R5 → 制作独立 HUB 和游戏入口 → 检查表单、布局与导出。
Read Git and handoff → verify R5 → create a separate HUB and game entry → check forms, layout and exports.
tech: 复用锁定的 R5 视觉样式；新增本机独立草稿、结构化报告与 ZIP 打包，不接入外部收费服务。
Reuse locked R5 styling; add separate local drafts, structured reports and ZIP packaging without an external paid service.
result: 原游戏 index 与 bundle 保留；新的 play 入口只加课堂工具栏和安全区。HUB 版本号不代表新玩法已实现。
Original index and bundle retained; the new play entry adds a classroom toolbar and safe areas. A HUB release is not a new gameplay feature.

title: 儿童实机测评 → 下一轮决定
Children’s device test → next decision
summary: Joey、Mia、Chloe 各填写自己的体验，提出一个功能并说明原因。未预填评价或成绩。
Joey, Mia and Chloe each record their experience and propose one feature with a reason. No reviews or scores are pre-filled.
brief: Joey、Mia、Chloe 各填写自己的体验，提出一个功能并说明原因。未预填评价或成绩。
Joey, Mia and Chloe each record their experience and propose one feature with a reason. No reviews or scores are pre-filled.
tool: 试玩 → 保存报告 → 导出交给老师 → 老师核对，再确定修改范围。
Play → save a report → export it for the teacher → verify and choose a change.
tech: 本机报告不自动跨 iPad 同步；老师可导入各设备 JSON 汇总。未来功能不自动进入开发。
Reports do not automatically sync across iPads; the teacher can import their JSON files. Feature ideas do not automatically trigger development.
result: 计划中：真实 iPad、儿童反馈和最终版本仍待确认。
Planned: physical-iPad results, child feedback and the final build are not yet confirmed.

title: 先试玩，再逐个说不同意见
Play first, then contribute distinct feedback
summary: 每人说不同的优点/问题，认真听前一个人；指出操作、位置和失败表现。课堂记录未有人完成旧版。
Each child contributes a distinct strength/problem, listens, and describes the action, location and failure. No completion was reported in that playtest.
brief: 每人说不同的优点/问题，认真听前一个人；指出操作、位置和失败表现。课堂记录未有人完成旧版。
Each child contributes a distinct strength/problem, listens, and describes the action, location and failure. No completion was reported in that playtest.

tools: Git 记录全游戏、测试与素材实现。具体模型和逐请求 Token 回执尚未核实，不从提交作者猜测。
Git records the full game, tests and assets. Exact model and per-request token receipts are unverified; commit authors do not establish model identity.
tech: JavaScript 模块分离状态、碰撞、任务、小狗、输入、存档、绘制和音效。
JavaScript modules separate state, collision, quests, puppy, input, saves, rendering and audio.
result: 实现提交 5a1db9d；后续测试与修订继续保留。
Implementation commit 5a1db9d, followed by reviews and refinements.

title: 点击移动与离线入口
Tap-to-move and the offline entry
brief: 降低操作门槛：点地面移动、点击交互提示；补屏幕操作说明。
Lower the control barrier with ground taps, clickable interaction prompts and on-screen instructions.
tools: 提交 aac8dc3 增加操作和 bundle；392ed68 整理仓库依赖，不是一套新游戏。
Commit aac8dc3 adds controls and a bundle; 392ed68 cleans repository dependencies, not a different game.
tech: src/data → 构建脚本 → 单文件 bundle.js；运行时不依赖 Node 或在线模型。
src/data → build script → standalone bundle.js; the game does not require Node or an online model at runtime.
result: 已有游戏支持直接浏览器运行；核心任务方向未改变。
The existing game can run in the browser without changing the core quest direction.

title: 独立主线复核与三项跟进
Independent core review and three follow-ups
brief: 通过真实输入完成滑梯、动物园、小狗、夜游线索和星灯结局。中文与触屏不能因核心通关而自动通过。
Real-input checks cover the slide, zoo, puppy, night clues and finale. A core pass does not automatically certify language or touch quality.
tools: 记录中的 Chromium 主线无传送、无胜利状态注入；另有 WebKit 触屏冒烟和单元测试 10/10。
The recorded Chromium run used no teleport or injected victory state. Separate WebKit touch smoke checks and 10/10 unit tests are documented.
tech: 旧测试中的坐标夹具单列；增加真实路径证据，并验证 bundle 与源码一致。
Older coordinate fixtures remain a separate test category; real-route evidence and bundle/source consistency were added.
result: PASS_CORE / ACCEPT_WITH_FOLLOWUPS；AW-01 中文、AW-02 触屏、AW-03 可重复主线仍有跟进。
PASS_CORE / ACCEPT_WITH_FOLLOWUPS, with AW-01 language, AW-02 touch and AW-03 reproducible-route follow-ups.

title: 区分文档回退与游戏版本
Separate documentation rollback from gameplay
brief: 历史中出现文档归档及其回退，不能据此断言游戏重新开发或已经丢失。
The history contains a documentation archive and its revert; that does not establish a gameplay rebuild or loss.
tools: 核对当前 Git HEAD、归档/回退提交与运行文件指纹。
Checked current Git HEAD, archive/revert commits and runtime file fingerprints.
tech: 当前源仓库 HEAD 为 90a9d48；公开试玩 bundle 的 Git blob 与该仓库一致。
Source HEAD is 90a9d48; the published playable bundle has the same Git blob as the source repository.
result: 继续使用已核验核心基线，不把较新的文档提交当作更高游戏版号。
Continue the reviewed core baseline; a newer documentation commit is not a higher gameplay release.

title: R5 HUB 与独立测评记录
R5 HUB and individual playtest records
brief: 接入老师锁定的 R5，呈现共创过程、预算、已知问题；让每位孩子从 HUB 试玩并写报告。
Apply the teacher-approved R5, showing shared ideas, budget and known issues; let each child play from the HUB and write a report.
tools: 读取 Git 与交接单 → 校验 R5 → 制作独立 HUB 和游戏入口 → 检查表单、布局与导出。
Read Git and handoff → verify R5 → create a separate HUB and game entry → check forms, layout and exports.
tech: 复用锁定的 R5 视觉样式；新增本机独立草稿、结构化报告与 ZIP 打包，不接入外部收费服务。
Reuse locked R5 styling; add separate local drafts, structured reports and ZIP packaging without an external paid service.
result: 原游戏 index 与 bundle 保留；新的 play 入口只加课堂工具栏和安全区。HUB 版本号不代表新玩法已实现。
Original index and bundle retained; the new play entry adds a classroom toolbar and safe areas. A HUB release is not a new gameplay feature.

title: 儿童实机测评 → 下一轮决定
Children’s device test → next decision
brief: Joey、Mia、Chloe 各填写自己的体验，提出一个功能并说明原因。未预填评价或成绩。
Joey, Mia and Chloe each record their experience and propose one feature with a reason. No reviews or scores are pre-filled.
tools: 试玩 → 保存报告 → 导出交给老师 → 老师核对，再确定修改范围。
Play → save a report → export it for the teacher → verify and choose a change.
tech: 本机报告不自动跨 iPad 同步；老师可导入各设备 JSON 汇总。未来功能不自动进入开发。
Reports do not automatically sync across iPads; the teacher can import their JSON files. Feature ideas do not automatically trigger development.
result: 计划中：真实 iPad、儿童反馈和最终版本仍待确认。
Planned: physical-iPad results, child feedback and the final build are not yet confirmed.
